Industrial

in-DUS-tree-uhl · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Industrial is relating to factories, machines, and manufacturing.

The industrial part of town is full of factories with tall smokestacks.

Worked Example

The museum showed an industrial machine that once stitched hundreds of shirts a day.

A machine from a factory that made shirts is part of manufacturing. Things connected to factories and machines are industrial.

How Industrial Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

manufacturing

manufacturing: about making goods with machines

factory

factory: of or from factories

Antonyms

natural

natural: made by nature, not machines

handmade

handmade: made by hand, not machines

How Strong Is It? — Mechanical → industrial → High-tech

Mechanical vs. industrial

Mechanical vs. industrial: Mechanical is smaller: one mechanical pencil has moving parts, while a whole industrial district is full of machines.

High-tech vs. industrial

High-tech vs. industrial: High-tech is even bigger: a high-tech plant uses robots and computers to run almost everything.

Put it together

Put it together: Industri- means hard work, so industrial describes places and things built around the work of factories and machines.
